I rode 81 miles on a Brooks Cambium c17 yesterday. Cambium is their rubber saddle line. Yeah, 81 is not quite a century, but cut me some slack. It's the most riding I've ever done in one day. I've been seriously riding nearly every day for only a year now, and previously my most miles in a day topped out between 30-40. So you can imagine that jumping up to 81 is a big deal for me, especially when carrying about 15 pounds of crap on a bike that already weighs nearly 30 pounds by itself.

Today, the back of my neck is a little sore. My legs are ever so slightly tender, but it's negligible. My whole body feels generally tired, but okay. As for my butt? It's 100% fine. The c17 saddle performed like a champ. I'm very impressed with it. Without that saddle, I would have struggled past 20 miles. That's about as far as I could go previously before feeling some seriously awful discomfort.

Oh yeah, one more little detail. I rode all 81 miles in a pair of bluejeans. Bravo, c17. Bravo.
